No uniformly bounded-negative-index Hermitian generalized pencil can realize these shorter cofactors.
The exact original central polynomial has the five-term decomposition, preserving every target.
Odd spectator cofactor coefficient cost is bounded by (1+epsilon/(2s_m^2))*K_N(epsilon)^2, with log K_N<=N sqrt(epsilon)/2.
open: Stability or PSD representations for the full D=R_(m-1) and T=R_m are not proved.

The hard-edge argument gives no positive fraction of nonreal roots or exponential spectral cost.
